core_evidence.git_diff: Exact changed paths and patch identity from the frozen scenario.
core_evidence.source_graph: Deterministic TypeScript static import graph rooted in src and public entrypoints; unresolved or dynamic imports make evidence incomplete.
core_evidence.complete_only_when: Target SHA, catalog, patch, adapter version, and all changed-path mappings validate without an unresolved edge.

native_evidence.role: Each native-selected test check is normalized as an additional impacted verification component; it does not replace core evidence or policy.
native_evidence.missing_behavior: Missing or invalid native evidence marks impact evidence incomplete and denies targeted skipping.

policy_rules.effect: require format, typecheck, lint, and build tags

policy_rules.condition: incomplete dependency evidence, unknown changed path, missing required native evidence, or unresolved import
policy_rules.effect: FULL when the catalog is complete; otherwise INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE

skip_rule: A test check may be skipped only when its scope does not intersect the complete affected closure, no native evidence selects it in the native-evidence arm, and no policy rule requires it. Every skip records evidence and policy references.
